issue: V8-OPENING-QUESTION: attach colon to its actual mystery question, before cast transition.

text:
If you are in, this is the moment.
Choose the name and call sign you want us to use. Someone can help you write them.
Beside the Case Table stands a small certification rack. Five badges hang on it. Hook 06 is empty.
Mimi slides a pencil over. "Start with your name."
issue: V8-ACCESSIBLE-CREDENTIAL: retain reader choice while allowing a scribe or family help.

text:
Your call sign is a detective nickname you choose. Use the same one whenever the book asks.
Your best detective skill can be anything useful: noticing tiny details, remembering odd facts, asking good questions, staying calm, drawing maps, spotting patterns - or something only you know how to do.
The credential gets you into the investigation.
The cases decide what kind of detective you become.
issue: V8-CALLSIGN-DEFINITION: explain required finale input at first use.

text:
HINT VAULT + SOLUTION FILES
Stuck? Find your case in the index on pages 148–149. It lists all three hint pages and the solution page.
HINT LEVEL 1: A small nudge.
HINT LEVEL 2: Narrow the search.
HINT LEVEL 3: A bigger push.
SOLUTION FILES: Full answers and explanations.
Read only your case's entry to avoid other answers. You can pause, try again or work with someone. Using a hint counts as detective work.
issue: V8-EARLY-SUPPORT: expose navigation and help permission before Case01, not only in backmatter.

text:
By the end of the first stretch of cases, nobody asks whether you are coming with them anymore. Mimi just leaves space beside the next file. Real staff have asked for help. Your filed answers have woken part of an old Academy system. It still has not explained why.

On the Case Wall, four matching marks wait beside an incomplete route.
issue: V8-FUNCTION-REPETITION: remove second identical place-beside-file belonging beat within same bridge.

text:
Bibi studies your filed classification and taps the matching Academy form once.
"This is the form I remember," she says. "I do not remember what the zero meant."
She takes the copy to the archive to check it against the original.
For once, nobody fills the gap with a tunnel.
Under OPEN QUESTIONS, add one note beneath the question you already saved: BIBI RECOGNIZES THE OLD FORM. ZERO'S MEANING STILL UNKNOWN.

text:
For one whole minute, the Academy manages to be quiet.
Almost.
The team puts down its pencils. Bibi closes the Book 1 routing log and slides it into the archive tray.
Beside it is a small release flap.
Dilo leans forward, then stops and looks at Bibi.
"May I?"
Bibi checks that the routing log is safely filed, then nods.
He lifts the flap gently.
